name: S4

protocolDosing.notes: split dosing required due to short t½ (~4–6 h); reversible yellow-tint vision risk increases at ≥50 mg/day

effects: reversible xanthopsia/yellow-tint vision (ocular AR binding, esp. ≥50 mg/day; resolves ~2–3 days post-cessation)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Oral androgen receptor partial agonist (Ki ~4 nM); tissue-selective; notable ocular AR binding.
mechanismOfAction.description: Nonsteroidal SARM; AR partial agonist with Ki ~4 nM; weaker androgenic activity at prostate vs full agonists. Critically binds ocular ARs causing reversible yellow-tint vision and night-vision impairment, especially at doses ≥50 mg/day. Short t½ (~4–6 h) requires split dosing.
